description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and identities, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
